title: Lag script
script:
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
gui.Name = "BlockTrollGUI"

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 420)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", frame)

-- Function to create buttons
local function createButton(text, position, color)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, position)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
	return btn
end

-- Block folder
local folder = Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
folder.Name = "SpawnedTrollBlocks"

-- Spawn function
local function spawnBlocks(amount)
	for i = 1, amount do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		part.Position = Vector3.new(
			math.random(-1000, 1000),
			math.random(10, 500),
			math.random(-1000, 1000)
		)
		part.Color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 1, 1)
		part.Parent = folder
		if i % 1000 == 0 then task.wait() end
	end
end

-- Buttons
local btn100k = createButton("🧱 Spawn 100K", 10, Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0))
local btn400k = createButton("🔥 Spawn 400K", 60, Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0))
local btn600k = createButton("💥 Spawn 600K", 110, Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 0))
local btn1m   = createButton("💣 Spawn 1 MILLION", 160, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
local btn4m   = createButton("☠️ Spawn 4 MILLION", 210, Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255))
local btn6m   = createButton("👹 Spawn 6 MILLION", 260, Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255))
local btn9m   = createButton("😈 Spawn 9 MILLION", 310, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0))
local btn1b   = createButton("💀 Spawn 1 BILLION", 360, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))

local clearBtn = createButton("❌ Clear All Blocks", 410, Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0))

-- Button binds
btn100k.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(100000) end)
btn400k.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(400000) end)
btn600k.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(600000) end)
btn1m.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(1000000) end)
btn4m.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(4000000) end)
btn6m.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(6000000) end)
btn9m.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(9000000) end)
btn1b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spawnBlocks(1000000000) end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		v:Destroy()
	end
end)
